document.title: Disappearing plant and animal species
document.question:
Many species of plants and animals are disappearing at a faster rate than ever before. Some blame the destruction of natural habitats, while others point to pollution and climate change.

What are the causes of this problem, and what solutions can you suggest?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
